status: Partial source increment: shared navigation/panels and one controlled text field, four framework form bridges and a real Storybook catalog. Other families and complete delivery/application acceptance remain required.
implemented: Shared controlled navigation/panels and a single-line text field; immutable pure contracts, explicit client registration, original typed cancelable events and one visual implementation per family.

Real React/Vue/Angular/Svelte navigation and single-line text-field bindings. Renderer imports stay type-only; runtime shared imports are DOM-independent validation policies plus each adapter own framework. No alternate visuals.

391 passing Node/Chromium contract, architecture, CI, component/binding and Storybook interaction/a11y tests; all 25 authored runtime modules are inventoried independently, including Svelte and three zero-executable modules. CSF test definitions delegate runtime composition to covered example modules.
Strict source and consumer-tool types plus Svelte package/test-fixture checks; no library checks skipped. Angular APF and Svelte declarations built by official package tools.
All five unpublished coordinates independently built/packed twice with identical bytes. Actual installed sources and publication metadata verified.

Four real clean frozen offline consumers compile installed package declarations and exercise navigation plus controlled text-field editing/cancellation/model writes/native default submitter/validation/disable/reset/EN-ES/themes/teardown/remount in Chromium; no foreign framework is installed.
Angular actual consumer is AOT compiled and uses the official linker for all partial framework libraries, without a JIT fallback.

Core text field passes actual form ownership/submission, default submitter, required/length/custom validation, disabled fieldsets, readonly, reset, explicit restoration callbacks, focus/labels, controlled caret, composition-boundary and invalid-input regression tests. Its actual installed package passes compiled Chromium form journeys.

Angular text field implements ControlValueAccessor and the shared pure Validator: reactive controls, ngModel, nullable/nonnullable reset, dirty/touched and updateOn change/blur/submit pass. Foreign malformed event payloads are rejected before callbacks; validated snapshots survive observer payload mutation.

Sixteen real production-backed CSF stories and three autodocs pages; static /ha-ui/ matrix covers 32 locale/theme/width combinations, reduced motion, local-only assets, native forms, manual keyboard panels, actual manager controls and toolbar updates.
Storybook found and regressed two shared renderer issues: insufficient light error contrast and partially clipped focused navigation destinations. Both reproduce before their common fixes.

Fresh hosted CI and complete native Bugbot review are required for the source head.
